ACTUAL_RESOURCE_LIMIT: Only the owner's actual project-controlled resources and permissions; no permission outside them inferred
EXACT_INITIATING_LIMIT: Treat these declarations as initiating governance evidence, not as an already issued charter or execution authorization.
EXACT_OWNER_AUTHORITY_DECLARATION: The project owner has explicitly declared authority to establish and approve KGE-Forge qualification governance rules.
EXACT_SCOPE_LIMITATION: The project owner has explicitly limited the proposed charter to **qualification governance only**.
IDENTITY_POLICY: Retain declared project-owner role and trusted user-message provenance; do not infer a legal identity, credentials or authority from repository username. The actual adopting actor must explicitly act as this declaring owner or evidence a designation.
